answer: Social Matters >> Nikah (Marriage) Question ID: 15373 Country: Pakistan Title: sir my mother and wife are distributed on the any matter my mother say to me given him talk I have 3 childern I refused . now my mother say that you take feed of my mother (Nani Aman)and this wife is illegally. your nakkah is broken my mother say i take oath so what i can do? Question: sir my mother and wife are distributed on the any matter my mother say to me given him talk I have 3 childern I refused . now my mother say that you take feed of my mother (Nani Aman)and this wife is illegally. your nakkah is broken my mother say i take oath so what i can do? Answer ID: 15373 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1393/1325=B/1430) In order to establish the fostering of grandmother, it is necessary to have witness of two men, the witness of your mother only is not sufficient. If the wife is better in her morals and conducts, do not give her talaq, in this case it is not necessary to obey mother. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
